traps.title: Airport taxi meter refusal
traps.description: Drivers quote inflated fixed fares and discourage the meter.
traps.tips: Agree to the meter before boarding or use the official taxi queue.

traps.title: Grand Palace tuk-tuk detour
traps.description: A cheap ride becomes a long detour to gem or tailor shops.
traps.tips: Use a map and decline unsolicited attraction stops.

traps.title: River pier ticket switch
traps.description: Unofficial sellers redirect visitors to expensive private boats.
traps.tips: Buy tickets at the marked public pier booth.

traps.title: Closed temple claim
traps.description: Drivers claim a landmark is closed and offer a shopping detour.
traps.tips: Check opening hours at the official entrance.

traps.title: Fake licensed guide
traps.description: Unlicensed guides offer a low price then demand a large tip.
traps.tips: Agree on total duration and price before starting.

traps.title: Menu price mismatch
traps.description: A verbal special price differs from the bill or excludes service.
traps.tips: Confirm the written menu price and service charge.

traps.title: Airport transfer switch
traps.description: A tout impersonates a transfer desk then adds surprise fees.
traps.tips: Use your pre-booked operator’s name and pickup point.

traps.title: Floating market photo fee
traps.description: A short boat ride is sold without disclosing per-person fees.
traps.tips: Ask whether the quoted fare covers the whole boat.

traps.title: Amber Fort guide pressure
traps.description: Unofficial guides approach at the gate and demand extra payment.
traps.tips: Check credentials and agree on a fixed total price.

traps.title: Pink City gem detour
traps.description: A ride includes a supposedly complimentary stop at a commission shop.
traps.tips: State your destination and decline shopping stops.

traps.title: Auto meter not used
traps.description: Drivers quote several times the local fare without a meter.
traps.tips: Agree a fare before boarding or use a trusted app.

traps.title: Elephant ride add-on
traps.description: The advertised price excludes queue, photo, or handling charges.
traps.tips: Ask for every fee in writing before paying.

traps.title: Closed palace diversion
traps.description: Drivers claim a site is closed and take visitors to a shop.
traps.tips: Confirm status at the official ticket counter.

traps.title: Restaurant menu surcharge
traps.description: A low menu price is followed by unlisted taxes or cover charges.
traps.tips: Check the final total and listed taxes before ordering.

traps.title: Airport prepaid taxi extra
traps.description: A prepaid fare is supplemented by an invented luggage fee.
traps.tips: Keep the official receipt and challenge unlisted charges.

traps.title: Photo guide tip demand
traps.description: A friendly stranger takes photos then demands a large tip.
traps.tips: Use your own camera and decline unsolicited services.

traps.title: Airport flat fare pitch
traps.description: Drivers offer a high fixed fare for a short city trip.
traps.tips: Use the meter or a licensed app; confirm any supplement.

traps.title: Tram 28 pickpocket diversion
traps.description: A distraction near a crowded tram stop masks a theft.
traps.tips: Keep valuables secured and use a zipped front pocket.

traps.title: Sintra tour extra fee
traps.description: A low tour quote excludes entry, tolls, or return transport.
traps.tips: Request a written all-inclusive itinerary and total.

traps.title: Restaurant cover charge
traps.description: Bread and olives appear on the bill despite seeming complimentary.
traps.tips: Ask which table items are charged; decline those you do not want.

traps.title: Fake ticket inspector
traps.description: A person requests an on-the-spot fine without proper ID.
traps.tips: Ask for official identification and a printed citation.

traps.title: Tuk-tuk route inflation
traps.description: A short ride becomes a long scenic loop with a surprise total.
traps.tips: Agree duration, route, and total fare before departure.

traps.title: Miradouro guide solicitation
traps.description: An unsolicited guide asks for a large tip after a short walk.
traps.tips: Set a total price up front or politely decline.

traps.title: Jemaa el-Fnaa guide ambush
traps.description: A stranger offers directions then demands payment or leads to a shop.
traps.tips: Decline unsolicited help and use a map.

traps.title: Medina shop detour
traps.description: A guide steers visitors to commission shops instead of the route.
traps.tips: Agree on a route and no-shopping stops before departure.

traps.title: Taxi no meter
traps.description: Drivers quote an inflated fare instead of using the meter.
traps.tips: Use the official taxi rank and agree the price first.

traps.title: Snake charmer photo fee
traps.description: A photo is taken or encouraged then billed at a high price.
traps.tips: Ask permission and settle the price before taking photos.

traps.title: Hammam package upsell
traps.description: A low entrance price excludes towel, scrub, or tip fees.
traps.tips: Confirm the complete package price before entering.

traps.title: Closed souk shortcut
traps.description: A driver claims the souk is closed and offers a paid detour.
traps.tips: Check with your hotel or official visitor information.

traps.title: Restaurant rooftop surcharge
traps.description: A menu excludes a view or service charge added at payment.
traps.tips: Check the posted menu and ask about service charges.
